purpose: Teach: こもり/思いがけない/片づけ/寝かせ/横顔/思い当たる/ホタル/育た

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家にこもりっきりじゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't stay cooped up at home all the time.
lines.style: Gentle but firm opening. Warm tone, the cadence of someone who cares enough to push back. A small lean forward — not scolding, but encouraging. Patient breath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、思いがけない一等賞だったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got first place. Didn't expect it.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. Not boasting — almost shy about it, checking her face to see if she's impressed. Slight lift at the end, wanting her to know what he did.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋の片づけはぼくが手伝うね
lines.en: Sho, I'll help you tidy up your room.
lines.style: Warm, practical offer. No fuss in the delivery — just stating what she's going to do. Soft and steady, the kind of care that doesn't announce itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、弟を寝かせてあげたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I helped put my little brother to sleep tonight.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride. Not showing off — reporting something he did that mattered. Quiet satisfaction in the tone. Eyes bright, waiting for recognition.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの横顔、優しいわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad has such a kind face in profile, doesn't he.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Tender observation. Slight pause before speaking, like she's seeing him in a quiet moment. Warm exhale — genuine noticing, not flattery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、思い当たる失敗あるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think I know what I messed up.
lines.style: Small, rueful laugh underneath. Self-aware but not harsh. Looking away slightly — owning something he got wrong. Dry but not unkind to himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、夏休みにホタルを見に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's go see the fireflies during summer break.
lines.style: Bright invitation. Forward momentum in the voice. Eager but not urgent — painting a picture of something she wants to share with him. Genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 日陰じゃ育たないお花、お庭にあるよ、メイ姉さん。メイ姉さん、ぼくの育てたお花、おっきく育ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, there's a flower in the garden that grows in shade. But look — the one I planted grew so big.
lines.style: Quiet wonder mixed with pride. Slight breathlessness on the second part, like he's showing her something he's been waiting for her to notice. Gentle pointing in the voice. Ending warm and satisfied.
